title: Patient Financial Services Fee Schedule — Missed-Appointment Fees under Appointment Scheduling
content:
Patient Financial Services publishes the missed-appointment fee amounts for every visit type booked under **Appointment Scheduling** at Riverbend Regional Health, together with the fee cap and the statement and dispute periods. Amounts are in US dollars.

## Fee table

| Visit type | No-show fee (USD) | Late-cancellation fee (USD) | Fee cap in the count window (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Primary Care Office Visit | 25.00 | 0.00 | 75.00 |
| Telehealth Video Visit | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Specialty New-Patient Consultation | 50.00 | 25.00 | 150.00 |
| Diagnostic Imaging Appointment (MRI/CT) | 50.00 | 25.00 | 150.00 |
| Infusion Therapy Chair Appointment | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Pre-Admission Testing Appointment | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Outpatient Procedure Appointment | 75.00 | 50.00 | 150.00 |

## Periods (the same for every visit type)

| Period | Calendar days |
|---|---|
| A fee appears on the patient statement this many days after assessment | 14 |
| The patient may dispute a fee within this many days after it is assessed | 60 |

## Footnotes to the schedule

1. The **no-show fee** is the fee for a no-show; the **late-cancellation fee** is the fee for a late cancellation by the patient.
2. The **fee cap** is the maximum of missed-appointment fees assessed to one patient in the rolling count window.
3. The Telehealth Video Visit, the Infusion Therapy Chair Appointment and the Pre-Admission Testing Appointment carry a no-show fee of 0.00, a late-cancellation fee of 0.00 and a fee cap of 0.00.
4. The Primary Care Office Visit carries a no-show fee of 25.00 but a late-cancellation fee of 0.00.

## Hypothetical illustration of the periods

*Hypothetical:* a fee assessed on day 0 of an invented calendar appears on the patient statement on day 14; the period of 60 calendar days within which the patient may dispute it is counted from that same assessment on day 0.
